economic_hypothesis: In a causally observed broad bull market with positive majority industry participation, a recent leader's first high-location, turnover-backed break above its five-session approach ceiling after an orderly pullback represents renewed active demand rather than a downward-gap repair.
entry: first legal daily open after signal, within three market sessions
exit: standing target from first T+1 session through the causal horizon decision; otherwise first legal open after the horizon decision
industry_gate: PIT industry n20 >= 5, median completed ret20 > 0, and positive-ret20 share > 0.50 at signal close

market_gate.BEAR: both medians <= 0 AND both positive-return shares <= 0.50
market_gate.BULL: market median ret20 > 0 AND positive-ret20 share > 0.50 AND market median ret60 > 0 AND positive-ret60 share > 0.50
market_gate.TRANSITION: all other combinations or missing required state
market_gate.strategy_action: trade only BULL; BEAR and TRANSITION hold cash

shared_semantics.history: exactly 60 prior valid completed same-symbol sessions
shared_semantics.leader_runup: prior20 coordinate high / prior60 coordinate low - 1
shared_semantics.pullback: previous coordinate close / prior20 coordinate high - 1
shared_semantics.reacceleration: current completed close first crosses above prior5 coordinate high; current step return, close location and turnover expansion satisfy rule
